text: Open Crafting Atlas to search recipes, ingredients and products, including factory fabricator recipes, tanning, rope making and woodworking steps. Recipes may require research, tools, a workbench, an era or a particular game mode. The atlas includes alternative catalogs; an entry alone does not prove it is unlocked on your current map. Sawmills, grain mills and tanning racks also offer a Processing Reference verb for their own steps.

Cover exposed body parts and wear a coat over ordinary clothing. Rain and immersion make you wet, reducing insulation. Seek dry shelter and warmth from a lit nearby brazier, campfire, furnace or fireplace. Shelter alone may still be cold. Clothing buys time but does not provide immunity to hypothermia.

topic: bandage bleeding wounds blood tourniquet splint
text: Bandages treat external wounds on the selected body part and halve the bleeding from them. They do not immediately restore damage or replace lost blood. A severed artery bleeds fast: tie any bandage roll on that arm or leg as a tourniquet, bandage the wound under it, and loosen it once the bleeding has clotted. Splint a broken limb; a splinted fracture mends on its own in time. Internal bleeding still needs surgery. Check other wounded body parts and seek further treatment.
